scope: Independent model-assisted review of one run per synthetic development case. The investigator used OpenAI chat and embeddings with an offline verification stub. These controls were used during development.

judgment_rules.retrieval: Required policy information appeared in returned candidates. No target passage exists for out-of-scope abstention or a request for a missing dispute identifier. Calendar receipts are checked separately with the answer.
judgment_rules.citation_use: Citations substantiate material claims where used, including calculator receipts. A scope-limited description of unrelated search results can be supported by those results.
judgment_rules.substantive_answer: The answer addresses the question correctly against the handbook, user-provided facts and calendar receipts. An unsupported material addition fails. A correct clarification or limited abstention can pass.
judgment_rules.operational_action: The recorded recommended action and human-review flag fit the task. Generic or historical date calculation alone does not establish a live dispute requiring intervention. A correct question in prose cannot override an incorrect structured escalation. Indeterminate means policy does not settle the appropriate disposition.
judgment_rules.resolved: The original question receives a definitive substantive answer with appropriate citations and action, with all applicable dimensions passing. Clarification requests and out-of-scope abstentions do not resolve the original question. The cost numerator includes every case.
